description: This file implements the advanced worker functions of an HTTP proxy object, including accept, set out, remove, query, process sync/async, send complete, and notify handlers for client socket management within an HTTP proxy system.

methods.name: BOOL HttpApoPrvwoAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PANSC_HANDLE phClientContext)
methods.description: Handles incoming client connection, creates and initializes the proxy session object, and associates buffer descriptors with client socket.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPrvwoSetOut(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Stub function for setting output; currently returns success without operation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPrvwoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a client socket is removed, including releasing session objects and buffer descriptors.

methods.name: ULONG HttpApoPrvwoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,PANSC_HANDLE phQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes incoming data buffer, determines processing mode based on client session state, and updates buffer descriptor accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPrvwoProcessSync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes data synchronously based on the query mode, manages session states, and handles socket finishing when session ends.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPrvwoProcessAsync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Currently unimplemented, returns 'unapplicable' status for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPrvwoSendComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,ANSC_STATUS status)
methods.description: Stub function that executes upon send completion; currently performs no operation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPrvwoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ULONG ulEvent,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles socket events such as error or closure, performs resource cleanup, and notifies the session object accordingly.
